Name: SimpleMute
Author: Anam Ahmed

Actions.Name: Toggle Microphone
Actions.Tooltip: Mutes or unmutes the microphone in the active Meet, Zoom or Teams web meeting.

Actions.Name: Toggle Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Turns the camera on or off in the active Meet, Zoom or Teams web meeting.

Description: Toggle your mic and camera in Google Meet, Zoom and Teams web meetings, with key icons that show live state. Requires the SimpleMute Chrome extension.
